verses.text: Then the man brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, the one facing east, and it was shut.
The LORD said to me, "This gate must stay shut. It must not be opened, and no one may go in through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, has gone in through it. So it must stay shut.
Only the prince may sit inside the gateway to eat a meal in the LORD's presence. He must come in through the porch of the gateway and go out the same way."
Then the man brought me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked and saw the glory of the LORD filling the LORD's temple, and I fell face down.

The LORD said to me, "Son of man, pay close attention. Look carefully and listen closely to everything I tell you about all the rules and laws of the LORD's temple. Pay close attention to who may enter the temple and who must be kept out of the sanctuary.
Say to the rebellious people of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: People of Israel, enough of all your disgusting practices!

You brought foreigners into my sanctuary, people uncircumcised in heart and body. They made my temple unholy while you offered me food, the fat and the blood. On top of all your other disgusting practices, you broke my covenant.
Instead of taking care of my holy things yourselves, you put foreigners in charge of my sanctuary.
This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner who is uncircumcised in heart and body may enter my sanctuary, not even a foreigner who lives among the people of Israel.
"'But the Levites who went far away from me when Israel wandered off after their idols will suffer the consequences of their sin.

They may still serve in my sanctuary, guarding the gates of the temple and working in the temple. They may slaughter the burnt offerings and sacrifices for the people and stand before the people to serve them.

But because they served the people in front of their idols and made Israel fall into sin, I have sworn with raised hand against them, says the Lord GOD, that they will suffer the consequences of their sin.
They must not come near me to serve as my priests, or come near any of my holy things or my most holy offerings. They must bear the shame of the disgusting things they did.
Yet I will put them in charge of the work of the temple, all its tasks and everything that must be done in it.

"'But the Levitical priests, the descendants of Zadok, faithfully took care of my sanctuary when the people of Israel wandered away from me. They may come near me to serve me. They will stand before me to offer me the fat and the blood, says the Lord GOD.
Only they may enter my sanctuary. Only they may come near my table to serve me and carry out my instructions.
"'When they go through the gates of the inner courtyard, they must wear linen clothes. They must not wear any wool while serving at the gates of the inner courtyard or inside the temple.
They must wear linen turbans on their heads and linen underwear. They must not wear anything that makes them sweat.

When they go out to the people in the outer courtyard, they must take off the clothes they served in and leave them in the holy rooms. They must put on other clothes, so their holy clothes do not make the people holy.
"'They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long. They must keep their hair trimmed.
No priest may drink wine before going into the inner courtyard.
They must not marry a widow or a divorced woman. They may marry only a virgin from the people of Israel, or the widow of a priest.
They must teach my people the difference between what is holy and what is common, and show them how to tell what is unclean from what is clean.
"'When there is a dispute, they will serve as judges and decide it by my rules. They must keep my laws and my decrees at all my appointed festivals, and keep my Sabbaths holy.
"'A priest must not make himself unclean by going near a dead body. But he may do so for his father, mother, son, daughter, brother, or unmarried sister.
After he has been made clean, he must wait seven days.
On the day he goes into the sanctuary, into the inner courtyard, to serve there, he must offer a sin offering for himself, says the Lord GOD.
"'The priests will have no inheritance except me. I am their inheritance. You must not give them any land of their own in Israel. I am their possession.
They will eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings. Everything in Israel that is devoted to the LORD will belong to them.
The best of all the first harvest and all the special gifts you bring will belong to the priests. You must give the priests the first part of your dough, so that a blessing will rest on your homes.
The priests must not eat any bird or animal that died on its own or was killed by wild animals.'"
